package librarytree_test

import("bufio";"bytes";"encoding/json";"os";"reflect";"strings";"sync";"testing";lint "zabaplint")
func primeData(t *testing.T)*lint.Checker{
 t.Helper();raw,err:=os.ReadFile("fixtures.json");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var input struct{Files []lint.File;Config string};if err=json.Unmarshal(raw,&input);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 c:=new(lint.Checker);c.Prime(input.Files,nil,input.Config);return c
}
func TestOriginalNodeSnapshots(t *testing.T){
 c:=primeData(t)
 raw,err:=os.ReadFile("reference.jsonl");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 lines:=bufio.NewScanner(bytes.NewReader(raw))
 for lines.Scan(){
  var want struct{Type,Name string;Value struct{Found bool;Files []lint.File;Tree *lint.Expression;SQLView *string;Components,Keys []string}}
  if err=json.Unmarshal(lines.Bytes(),&want);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  got:=want.Value;got.Files,got.Found=c.Files(want.Type,strings.ToLower(want.Name))
  if want.Type=="DDLS"{var found bool;got.Tree,got.SQLView,found=c.CDS(strings.ToLower(want.Name));if found!=got.Found{t.Fatal("CDS found")}}
  if want.Type=="TABL"||want.Type=="VIEW"{var found bool;got.Components,got.Keys,found=c.DDIC(want.Type,strings.ToLower(want.Name));if found!=got.Found{t.Fatal("DDIC found")}}
  if !reflect.DeepEqual(got,want.Value){t.Fatalf("%s %s\ngot: %#v\nwant: %#v",want.Type,want.Name,got,want.Value)}
 }
 if err=lines.Err();err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
}
func TestDataUpdatesAndCopies(t *testing.T){
 c:=primeData(t)
 tree,sql,found:=c.CDS("zdata");if !found||tree==nil||sql==nil||*sql!="ZSQLVIEW"{t.Fatal(tree,sql,found)}
 original:=tree.Text;tree.Text="changed";*sql="changed"
 again,sql,_:=c.CDS("ZDATA");if again.Text!=original||*sql!="ZSQLVIEW"{t.Fatal("CDS aliases registry")}
 raw:="define view entity zdata as select from ztab { key bKey }"
 before:=c.Stats();c.Update("zdata.ddls.asddls",&raw)
 changed,sql,found:=c.CDS("ZDATA");if !found||sql!=nil||changed==nil||!strings.Contains(changed.Text,"bKey")||c.Stats().ParseRuns!=before.ParseRuns+1{t.Fatal(changed,sql,c.Stats())}
 if again.Text!=original{t.Fatal("old snapshot changed")}
 // Missing lookups still parse pending edits before getObject.
 c.Update("zdata.ddls.asddls",&raw)
 c.Update("zbad.ddls.asddls",&raw);before=c.Stats();c.Files("TABL","MISSING")
 if c.Stats().ParseRuns!=before.ParseRuns+1{t.Fatal("missing Files lookup did not parse")}
 c.Update("zbad.ddls.asddls",nil)
 if n,s,f:=c.CDS("ZBAD");n!=nil||s!=nil||f{t.Fatal(n,s,f)}
 // Removing the source leaves a found DDLS metadata object with no tree.
 c.Update("zdata.ddls.asddls",nil)
 if n,s,f:=c.CDS("ZDATA");n!=nil||s!=nil||!f{t.Fatal(n,s,f)}
 c.Update("zdata.ddls.xml",nil)
 if fs,f:=c.Files("DDLS","ZDATA");fs!=nil||f{t.Fatal(fs,f)}
 components,keys,_:=c.DDIC("TABL","ZTAB");components[0]="changed";keys[0]="changed"
 components,keys,_=c.DDIC("TABL","ZTAB");if components[0]!="zKey"||keys[0]!="zKey"{t.Fatal(components,keys)}
 files,_:=c.Files("VIEW","ZVIEW");original=files[0].Raw;files[0].Raw="changed"
 files,_=c.Files("VIEW","ZVIEW");if files[0].Raw!=original{t.Fatal("Files aliases registry")}
}
func TestConcurrentDataReaders(t *testing.T){
 c,other:=primeData(t),primeData(t);var wg sync.WaitGroup
 for _,c:=range []*lint.Checker{c,other}{wg.Go(func(){for range 3{c.CDS("zdata");c.DDIC("TABL","ztab");c.DDIC("VIEW","zview");c.Files("DDLS","zdata")}})};wg.Wait()
}
